body.message:
Hi Chahana,

Thank you for the breakdown. However, I'm looking for a single fixed flat rate that stays exactly the same every month for the entire duration of my stay (October to June) — not a rate that varies month by month.

Is it possible to agree on one flat monthly rate for the whole period, averaged out, so I pay the same amount every month regardless of season?

If this isn't possible for a "monthly stay" booking, could you let me know if you offer a traditional long-term tenancy agreement (Ejari contract) instead, which typically has a fixed annual/monthly rent?

Thank you!
